en: A color postcard showing a wide boulevard lined with low‑rise, rectangular apartment blocks in a planned housing estate. There is a broad grassy median and open lawns, with a few small trees. Several mid‑20th‑century cars drive along the road under simple curved streetlamps. The architecture is stark, uniform, and functional, typical of socialist-era prefabricated housing. The sky is bright blue with a few clouds, and there is no printed title or caption visible on the front.
